metadata.description: Trantor — the hub-world for AI agent crews: live message bus, presence, project Kanban/flow board + context-handoff for independent AI coding agents (Claude, Codex, Gemini, …)

plugins.name: trantor
plugins.description: The hub-world for AI agent crews. Say "fire up the crew" and Claude becomes the architect: a plan-aware Advisor routes the work (solo / cheap inline calls / live crew of Codex, Gemini, Kimi & DeepSeek in their own terminal windows), a Kanban/flow command center with a testing gate tracks it, and an economics brain (Scrooge) keeps the receipts. Includes the relay MCP, a SessionStart auto-discovery hook, and a PreCompact context-handoff so a fresh session can take over a full window instead of compacting.
